line: One bee makes 1/12 of a teaspoon of honey in her life; the pen follows one yellow drop from flower to jar until the whole page is a poster.
line_cn: 一只蜜蜂一辈子只酿 1/12 茶匙蜜；笔跟着一滴黄从花走到罐子，最后整页成了一张海报。

camera.serves: a transformation; one thing carried elsewhere

camera.move: Pull back to the whole page

transitions: Transitions are camera moves over the same page.
No cuts to other pages, no fades, no page turns.
labels: Hand lettering only, licence-free and self-hosted: a bold casual hand for titles, banners and keywords (e.g. Kalam Bold, 34–84 px), a thin upright hand for notes (e.g. Patrick Hand, 26–32 px), a hand-written Chinese face for Chinese (e.g. ZCOOL KuaiLe, subset to the characters used). Avoid regular kai or sans faces: next to hand lettering they read as system fonts.
Hierarchy is part of the page: title on a banner with a yellow swash; keywords bold; notes thin and grey; numbers that matter get a yellow swash or a loop. At most four sizes on a page.
Each letter has a little tilt and bob (fixed seed), never perfectly aligned.
Micro notes (≈ 3 px on the page) may live inside an icon, readable only when the camera dives in; on the full page they read as texture.
motion: 24 fps. The camera is smooth on every frame; only the line wobble boils on twos.

Speed is the pen's speed: outlines in a quarter to half a second per element, words about as fast as a person writes them. Later sections may use several pens at once to build energy, never instant appearance.
Order inside one element: outline → paper fill → marker → shadow → label.
Marker bars in charts grow from the base with an ease-out; liquid fills rise from the bottom.

native_moves.name: The page writes itself
native_moves.does: Outline, marker, words, in that order, timed to the voice.
native_moves.fits: a recipe's steps; a meeting's decisions; how a law gets passed.

native_moves.name: One colour as the thread
native_moves.does: The single accent follows one thing through every block, so the page can be read by colour alone.
native_moves.fits: one euro through a supply chain; one signal through a nervous system; one idea through a book.

native_moves.name: Shape match cut
native_moves.does: Push into a round shape until it fills a set screen size, cut to another shape of the same size elsewhere on the page, pull back and draw the new context around it.
native_moves.fits: a seed becomes a tree; a coin becomes a bank vault; a cell becomes an organ.

native_moves.name: Dive into an icon
native_moves.does: A micro note written inside a drawing, readable only at 10× and more.
native_moves.fits: a chip's transistors; the ingredients inside a pill; a clause inside a contract.

native_moves.name: Ride the pen
native_moves.does: The camera follows the pen tip around an outline while a second pen fills nearby.
native_moves.fits: drawing a route on a map; tracing a timeline; outlining a building plan.

native_moves.name: The pull-back poster
native_moves.does: The last strokes are made in parallel while the camera pulls back; the final frame is a page you could print.
native_moves.fits: a lecture summary; a product one-pager; a year in review.

score.note: small, wooden and plucked; no pads, no drums
